* '''Trivia:

Originally played with mouse / joystick. Don't ask how (or why). Since returning in 2009, vodka has been a normal keyboard / mouse player. (Well, normalish.)

The nickname vodka ... Being Scottish and having the surname Todd, vodka is occasionally referred to as Toddy by drinking teammates (a toddy is a Scottish drink usually made with warmed whisky, water, and honey). But since vodka drinks only vodka (or Desperados), Toddy often becomes Voddy by the end of the evening. And hence the nick, vodka. Well, you did ask, didn't you?'''
